p: princes of Israel: That is, Jehoahaz and Jehoiakim, Josiah's sons, who for their pride and cruelty are compared to lions.
mother: That is Jehoahaz's mother, or Jerusalem.
nations also heard of him: By Pharaoh Nebo king of Egypt, 2Ki 23:33.
men: He slew the prophets and them that feared God and ravished their wives.
nations set against him on every: Nebuchadnezzar with his great army which was gathered from various nations.

mother is like a vine in: He speaks this in the reproach of this wicked king, in whose blood, that is in the race of his predecessors, Jerusalem would have been blessed according to God's promise and flourished as a fruitful vine.
east wind dried up her fruit: Meaning, that the Chaldeans would destroy them as the east wind does the fruit of the vine.
of a rod of her branches: Destruction is come by Zedekiah, who was the opportunity for this rebellion.
